pairs.locus: Martin of Braga, De trina mersione 4
pairs.question: Numquid quia Ariani Psalmum, Apostolum, Evangelia, et alia multa ita ut Catholici celebrant, nos errorum vicinitatem fugiendo haec sumus omnia reiecturi?
pairs.answer: Absit, quia illi, ex nobis ut scriptum est exeuntes, praeter minorationem Deitatis Filii Dei et Spiritus Sancti, cetera ita penes se retinent sicut nos.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question introduced by the interrogative Numquid, answered by the author himself. The answer is the full following sentence: it opens with Absit (the direct negative answer to the rhetorical question) and the quia clause gives the grounds. The window ends at the section-final full stop after sicut nos. The section marker [4] was stripped as scaffolding.
